summary: Robert Evans, Katy Stoll and Cody Johnston finish reading Ben Shapiro's novel True Allegiance, a right-wing thriller that ends with an Islamist nuclear attack on New York and a federal war on Texas, critiquing its politics and prose.

evidence.note: Hosts say this is the last session of a year-long reading of the novel
Hosts criticise the book's portrayal of nearly every Muslim character as a terrorist
Hosts note the book celebrates a military occupation of New York as reassuring
Assassination attempt subplot framed as a dig at liberals and the Black Lives Matter plot
Nuclear bombing of Air Force One over Manhattan, the novel's climax
Epilogue sets up federal government and China at war with Texas and the southern states
Book released shortly before Trump took office, which the hosts tie to Shapiro defending him
Closing talk about Daily Wire film ambitions and Shapiro as a pundit

notes: Final instalment of the True Allegiance reading; earlier parts may be separate stories. Publication year set to 2016 (transcript implies just before the Trump presidency); verify against the published edition. Setting is the novel's fictional US (New York, Texas); Mexico invasion is background only. No theme fits partisan fiction exactly; propaganda-media chosen as closest.
